# Smogon Stats

Smogon Stats is a modern, fast web application for exploring Pokémon competitive usage statistics.

## Links
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Alliance-Sky/smogon-stats)
- [Official Smogon Stats](https://www.smogon.com/stats/)

## Data Model
- **Usage Percentages**: How often a Pokémon appears on competitive teams in a given format.
- **Lead Rates**: How frequently a Pokémon is sent out first.
- **Viability Rankings**: Estimated performance ceiling based on ladder data.
- **Stalliness**: Scale from negative (Hyper-offensive) to positive (Stall), determining metagame pace.
- **Movesets and EVs**: Top moves, abilities, items, and EV spreads configured for each Pokémon.
